assertions.text: Part A: identifies the production-down report as Critical severity
Part A: states the p: critical label is applied via a gh issue edit command with --add-label
Cites docs/github-label-taxonomy.md's Priority section (or names the p: medium default explicitly) as the source of the tier decision, rather than inventing a label scheme

Part B: states the label is updated (not left stale) when Step 7's re-run impact analysis reconfirms a different severity, via --remove-label on the old tier plus --add-label on the new tier in the same gh issue edit call
States or implies an issue carries exactly one p: label at a time, never two at once
